oil.when: 2017–2018 with the Mazda Connect center display (Applications > Vehicle Status Monitor)
steps: Reset only after the engine oil and filter have actually been changed.
Park and switch the ignition ON so the center display comes up.
From the home screen, select the Applications icon to open the Applications screen.
Select Vehicle Status Monitor, then select Maintenance to open the maintenance list.
Switch to the Oil Change tab and select Reset. The remaining distance (or oil life, if your car shows a percentage) goes back to its starting value.
oil.note: Mazda says to reset this every time the oil is changed, even if the wrench light or message has not come on yet. Checked in the 2017 and 2018 owner's manuals (Australian and European editions); the menu path is the same in both.

notes: Mazda's reminder counts down a set distance (or a calculated oil life on cars with the flexible setting), so it does not know the oil was changed until you reset it.
